headline: Microsoft Consolidates Business Into Two Segments in Sweeping AI-Driven Overhaul
summary: Microsoft (MSFT) stock jumps nearly 3% as the tech giant overhauls its financial reporting into two AI-focused business segments.

headline: Wall Street Rallies as Fed’s Waller Hints at September Rate Hold: Stock Market Today
summary: Stocks rallied and Treasury yields retreated from three-year highs after Fed Governor Waller signaled he could back a rate hold, sending bitcoin above $80,000.
